Initial release — Bing Video Creator AI v1.0.0

- Generate 1080p MP4 videos from text prompts or images via a cloud-based backend.
- Upload MP4, MOV, PNG, or JPG files up to 200MB; download results in 1–2 minutes.
- Automatic setup connects to the processing API and handles token/session management.
- Supports editing, uploading, track management, export, and credit queries through simple chat prompts.
- Implements detailed error handling and workflow tips for best results.
